queries.name: bounds
queries.sql: SELECT start_ts,end_ts,(end_ts-start_ts)/1e9 AS seconds FROM trace_bounds

queries.name: topLevel
queries.sql: SELECT name,COUNT(*) AS calls,AVG(dur)/1e6 AS avg_ms,MAX(dur)/1e6 AS max_ms,SUM(dur)/1e9 AS sum_seconds FROM slice WHERE track_id=0 AND depth=0 AND dur>=0 GROUP BY name ORDER BY sum_seconds DESC LIMIT 15

queries.name: pairSummary
queries.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT id,ts,dur,LEAD(ts) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS next_ts FROM slice WHERE track_id=0 AND depth=0 AND name='ProcessFrame' AND dur>=0), r AS (SELECT p.id,p.ts,p.dur,p.next_ts,COUNT(c.id) AS renders,COALESCE(SUM(c.dur),0) AS render_dur,MIN(c.ts) AS render_start,MAX(c.ts+c.dur) AS render_end FROM p LEFT JOIN slice c ON c.track_id=0 AND c.depth=0 AND c.name='CoreManagerRender' AND c.dur>=0 AND c.ts>=p.ts AND c.ts<p.next_ts WHERE p.next_ts IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.id), pairs AS (SELECT *, (dur+render_dur)/1e6 AS paired_ms,(next_ts-ts)/1e6 AS interval_ms,(next_ts-MAX(ts+dur,COALESCE(render_end,ts+dur)))/1e6 AS gap_ms FROM r) SELECT COUNT(*) AS pairs,AVG(paired_ms) AS paired_mean_ms,MAX(paired_ms) AS paired_max_ms,AVG(interval_ms) AS interval_mean_ms,MAX(interval_ms) AS interval_max_ms,MAX(gap_ms) AS max_unaccounted_gap_ms,SUM(CASE WHEN renders<>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_single_render_pairs,SUM(CASE WHEN render_start<ts+dur THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overlap_pairs,SUM(CASE WHEN paired_ms<=8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pairs_within_8ms FROM pairs

queries.name: percentiles
queries.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT id,ts,dur,LEAD(ts) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS next_ts FROM slice WHERE track_id=0 AND depth=0 AND name='ProcessFrame' AND dur>=0), r AS (SELECT p.id,p.ts,p.dur,p.next_ts,COUNT(c.id) AS renders,COALESCE(SUM(c.dur),0) AS render_dur,MIN(c.ts) AS render_start,MAX(c.ts+c.dur) AS render_end FROM p LEFT JOIN slice c ON c.track_id=0 AND c.depth=0 AND c.name='CoreManagerRender' AND c.dur>=0 AND c.ts>=p.ts AND c.ts<p.next_ts WHERE p.next_ts IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.id), pairs AS (SELECT *, (dur+render_dur)/1e6 AS paired_ms,(next_ts-ts)/1e6 AS interval_ms,(next_ts-MAX(ts+dur,COALESCE(render_end,ts+dur)))/1e6 AS gap_ms FROM r), ranked AS (SELECT paired_ms,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY paired_ms) AS rn,COUNT(*) OVER () AS n FROM pairs) SELECT paired_ms,rn,n FROM ranked WHERE rn=CAST((n*0.5+0.999999) AS INT) OR rn=CAST((n*0.9+0.999999) AS INT) OR rn=CAST((n*0.99+0.999999) AS INT)

queries.name: worstGaps
queries.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT id,ts,dur,LEAD(ts) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS next_ts FROM slice WHERE track_id=0 AND depth=0 AND name='ProcessFrame' AND dur>=0), r AS (SELECT p.id,p.ts,p.dur,p.next_ts,COUNT(c.id) AS renders,COALESCE(SUM(c.dur),0) AS render_dur,MIN(c.ts) AS render_start,MAX(c.ts+c.dur) AS render_end FROM p LEFT JOIN slice c ON c.track_id=0 AND c.depth=0 AND c.name='CoreManagerRender' AND c.dur>=0 AND c.ts>=p.ts AND c.ts<p.next_ts WHERE p.next_ts IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.id), pairs AS (SELECT *, (dur+render_dur)/1e6 AS paired_ms,(next_ts-ts)/1e6 AS interval_ms,(next_ts-MAX(ts+dur,COALESCE(render_end,ts+dur)))/1e6 AS gap_ms FROM r) SELECT (ts-(SELECT start_ts FROM trace_bounds))/1e9 AS trace_seconds,paired_ms,interval_ms,gap_ms,renders FROM pairs ORDER BY gap_ms DESC LIMIT 10

queries.name: longestSlices
queries.sql: SELECT name,depth,(ts-(SELECT start_ts FROM trace_bounds))/1e9 AS trace_seconds,dur/1e6 AS ms,parent_id FROM slice WHERE track_id=0 AND dur>=0 ORDER BY dur DESC LIMIT 20

queries.name: renderChildren
queries.sql: SELECT name,depth,dur/1e6 AS ms FROM slice WHERE parent_id=(SELECT id FROM slice WHERE track_id=0 AND name='CoreManagerRender' AND dur>=0 ORDER BY dur DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY dur DESC LIMIT 20

queries.name: unclosed
queries.sql: SELECT name,depth,COUNT(*) AS slices FROM slice WHERE dur<0 GROUP BY name,depth ORDER BY slices DESC LIMIT 10

queries.name: scheduling
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS sched_count FROM sched
